nodes.name: Solution High-Temperature Shock
nodes.procedure: To prepare Co(Ac)2 solution, 10 ml glycol was added into 20 ml deionized water as solvent, 0.249 g Co(Ac)2 was added into solvent at room temperature and stirred for 1 h. The carbon cloth was cleaned adequately by acetone, ethanol and deionized water in ultrasound environment, and then dried in the air at 60 °C for 10 h. Then, the treated carbon cloth was fixed on a glass slide substrate by copper ribbons and sliver paste and dried in the air at 60 °C for 2 h. The heating process was started by adding current of 10 A for 1.5 min. The sample was washed by deionized water for three times to remove precursor solution.

nodes.name: Co-precipitation
nodes.procedure: 15 mmol L-1 Co(NO3)2·6H2O was uniformly dispersed in 50 ml deionized water. Then, 25 ml NaOH solution with the concentration of 2 mol L-1 was quickly introduced into the above clear solution. After stirring for 2 h, the resulting powder was washed three times with deionized water and ethanol and finally put into the oven for drying.
